text:
alex ng: Heads-up — PR #4510 (lightweight style + tiny rename) is ready for merge. primarily formatting + a single var rename. CI green locally. Can someone give quick approval? cc @jordan r @sam lee

jordan r: taking a look now. Did you run gofumpt? we had a new hook land yesterday.

alex ng: yep ran gofumpt + pre-commit, only changed comments and one var: ctxUserID -> userCtxID to match proto. didn't touch proto gen. diff is tiny.

sam lee: quick nit — prefer 'userIDCtx' in our codebase? iirc we standardized on suffix ID only sometimes. not a blocker though. can you show the snippet?

alex ng: sure
```diff
- func extract(ctx context.Context) string {
-    uid := ctx.Value("ctxUserID").(string)
-    return uid
-}
+ func extract(ctx context.Context) string {
+    uid := ctx.Value("userCtxID").(string)
+    return uid
+}
```

maria gonzalez: tiny nit from me: can you add a comment on why we picked that name? helps future PRs. otherwise :thumbsup:

jordan r: CI bot shows one lint failure on eng/audit.go line 72 (exported var should have doc). likely unrelated but will block merge. @ci-bot can you paste the failing job?

ci-bot: [ci] Lint failed: eng/audit.go:72: exported var 'AuditURL' missing comment (golint). See https://ci.redwood/in/4510

alex ng: ugh thanks. will fix that quick and push. also, do we need squash commits? there's 3 tiny commits.

sam lee: please squash into 1 commit. makes backfills easier. also rebase onto main to pick latest formatter hook.

alex ng: will do. pushing in ~10m.

autoformat-bot: autoformat will be re-run on push. If you need exemption, add 'format-exempt' label to PR.

alex ng: no exemption, will reformat. queueing now.

jordan r: once CI passes, I'll give an approval. If anyone else wants to be final reviewer ping here.

maria gonzalez: ok to merge after jordan's approval + CI green. thanks!

alex ng: planning to merge after 3pm PT (off-peak). no hot deploys scheduled — will merge on green and add short merge note.

sam lee: sounds good.

alex ng: pushed squashed commit and fixed lint (added comment). CI running: https://ci.redwood/in/4510/123

ci-bot: [ci] All checks passed.

jordan r: approved :white_check_mark: merging when you have the window.

alex ng: merged. thanks all! :tada:
